description: Lifecycle and policy-change scenarios S1 to S5 (docs/spec/08 section 6) over the synthetic book fixtures/portfolio/book.json. Every `expect` was derived by the Python oracle (tools/verify_golden.py --derive-scenarios) before the TypeScript existed, then pinned. Never edit an expected value to make a test pass. diff cases compare a baseline and a candidate policy for every book customer; lifecycle cases walk dated steps and injected events and list the obligations due after each step.

spec 08 S1: the delisted knob flipped to hold_auto_high; nobody changes
